[h1]About the wallpaper[/h1]
This is my first web wallpaper  ( still in progress ☝️🤓)
♡ hope you like it and enjoy it ♡

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Custom Background color and images
 [*] Information Panel
 [*] Audio Integration
 [*] Clock
 [*] Floating Clock
 [*] Alarm
 [*] ToDo list and notes
 [*] Calendar (compatible with Google calendar .ics)
 [*] Custom Image Window
 [*] Mouse Trail
 [*] Audio Spectre
 [*] Weather Panel
 [*] Cpu / Memory Usage 
 [*] Customizable text
 [*] Battery Charge 
 [*] Search Bar
 [*] Shortcuts and More
[/list]
